# Nanonets OCR

Nanonets OCR extracts structured data from documents using trained, model-based OCR workflows.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/nanonets-ocr/.

## Actions

- **Extract From Public URL**: Synchronously extract model-defined fields and tables from one publicly reachable document URL.
- **Get OCR Model** (read-only): Get readiness, accuracy, extraction fields, and table configuration for one Nanonets OCR model.
- **Get OCR Prediction File** (read-only): Get normalized extraction results for every page of one previously processed Nanonets OCR file.
- **Get OCR Prediction Page** (read-only): Get normalized extracted fields and tables for one OCR prediction page.
- **List OCR Models** (read-only): List the OCR models available to the connected Nanonets account, including each model's ID, readiness state, and extraction categories.
- **List OCR Predictions** (read-only): List compact OCR prediction-page summaries for a model within an inclusive UTC date range.
